tools.name: read_web_page
tools.description: Read a public web page and return its main content as clean Markdown with title, author, publish date and language. Use when you need to read, quote or summarise an article or docs page from a URL.

tools.name: eu_power_prices
tools.description: Day-ahead wholesale electricity prices for a European bidding zone (DE-LU, FR, NL, AT, BE, PL, ...) for up to 31 days in local time, with daily min/max/mean and the cheapest and priciest N-hour window. Use when scheduling EV charging, heat pumps or batteries, or asked what power costs tomorrow.

tools.name: us_company_fundamentals
tools.description: Reported financials of a US-listed company from SEC 10-K/10-Q filings by ticker: revenue, profit, EPS, cash flow, free cash flow, assets, debt, equity and margins, annual or quarterly. Use when analysing or comparing US stocks and you need filed numbers, not estimates.

tools.name: us_company_filings
tools.description: Latest SEC EDGAR filings of a US-listed company by ticker with links, optionally filtered by form (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, 4 for insider trades, 13F-HR, S-1). Use for recent disclosures or insider filings.

tools.name: evm_gas_fees
tools.description: Current gas fees on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon: base fee and slow/standard/fast priority and max fee in gwei plus the cost of a plain transfer. Use before sending a transaction.

tools.name: app_store_reviews
tools.description: User reviews of a mobile app from the Apple App Store or Google Play, by app id, package name or store URL: rating, text, date, version and developer reply, plus rating counts. Use to analyse app feedback.

tools.name: website_contact_details
tools.description: Contact details of a company website: emails, phones, social profiles, name and address, from its home, contact, about and imprint pages. Use to find how to reach a business or enrich a lead.

tools.name: app_store_details
tools.description: Details of a mobile app on the App Store or Google Play by id, package name or store URL: developer, developer email, rating, installs, price, genre and update date. Use for app or competitor research.

tools.name: app_store_search
tools.description: Search the App Store or Google Play (store: google or apple) for a keyword and get up to 50 apps in rank order with full details. Use for ASO keyword research or finding competing apps.

tools.name: bess_arbitrage_revenue
tools.description: Battery storage (BESS) day-ahead arbitrage revenue for a European bidding zone over up to a year of historical prices: annualised revenue per MW, cycles and payback. Use when sizing or screening a battery project or comparing zones. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: crypto_token_prices
tools.description: Current USD price and 24h change for up to 20 crypto tokens per call, by symbol (BTC, ETH, SOL, PEPE), CoinGecko id or chain:contract address (base:0x833589..., ethereum:0x...). Covers thousands of coins and on-chain tokens. Use for portfolio valuation, trading decisions or answering what a token co

tools.name: evm_wallet_balance
tools.description: Balances of a wallet address or ENS name on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon in one call: native ETH/POL, USDC, USDT, DAI and any ERC-20 contracts you add, each with USD value and a total. Use to check whether a wallet is funded, value a portfolio or confirm a payment arrived.

tools.name: evm_transaction_status
tools.description: Status of an EVM transaction by hash: pending, success or failed, block, confirmations, timestamp, from/to, value, gas used, fee (plus L1 fee on Base/Optimism) and ERC-20 token transfers. Searches Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon if no chain is given. Use to confirm a payment settled.

tools.name: ens_resolve
tools.description: Resolve an ENS name (vitalik.eth) or Basename (jesse.base.eth) to its address and profile records (avatar, url, twitter, github, email, description), or an address to its verified primary name. Use before sending funds to a name or to show who owns a wallet.

tools.name: defi_yields
tools.description: Best DeFi yields right now: lending, staking and liquidity pools across all chains and protocols, with APY (base + rewards), 30-day mean APY, TVL, stablecoin flag and impermanent-loss risk. Filter by chain, protocol, token and minimum TVL; sort by APY or TVL. Use to find where to earn on USDC, ETH e

tools.name: crypto_news
tools.description: Latest crypto news from CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt and The Block in one feed, newest first, with title, link, time, summary and tags; filter by keyword or coin (BTC, ETH, SOL, ETF, Base). Use to explain a price move, brief a trader or monitor a project.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.description: DNS records of a domain: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA and CAA, plus SPF and DNSSEC status, via Cloudflare/Google DNS-over-HTTPS. Use to check where a domain points, its mail servers, verification TXT records or why email or a website is failing.

tools.name: domain_whois
tools.description: Registration data of a domain from RDAP, the official WHOIS successor: registrar, creation, update and expiry dates, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC and registrant organisation/country where public. Says whether an unregistered name looks available. Use for domain research, due diligence or phishi

tools.name: url_metadata
tools.description: Link-preview metadata of a web page: title, description, Open Graph and Twitter card image, site name, author, publish date, language, canonical URL, favicon and RSS feeds. Use to build link previews, enrich bookmarks or classify a URL without reading the full page.

tools.name: email_validate
tools.description: Check an email address before sending: syntax, whether the domain exists and has mail servers (MX), disposable/temporary provider, role address (info@, sales@), free provider and typo suggestion (gmial.com -> gmail.com), with a verdict. No mail is sent and the mailbox is not probed.

tools.name: qr_code
tools.description: Generate a QR code for any text, URL, wallet address or payment link as SVG or PNG, returned inline as SVG markup and a base64 data URI ready for HTML or chat. Choose size, border and error correction. Use when a user needs a scannable code for a link, Wi-Fi, contact or crypto payment.

tools.name: fx_rates
tools.description: Official ECB reference exchange rates for about 35 currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY, INR, AED, SAR and more) for today or any date since 1999, from any base currency, with optional amount conversion. Use to convert prices, invoices or salaries between currencies.

tools.name: us_treasury_yields
tools.description: US Treasury par yield curve from 1 month to 30 years (percent) for the latest day or any date since 1990, with 10y-2y and 10y-3m spreads, inversion flag and up to 60 days of history. Use for risk-free rates, discounting, macro analysis or answering where 10-year yields are.

tools.name: public_holidays
tools.description: Public holidays of 150+ countries and their states/regions, or stock-market holidays (NYSE, ECB TARGET), for any year, and whether a given date is a holiday or business day with the next business day. Use for scheduling, delivery dates, payroll or market-open checks.

tools.name: read_rss_feed
tools.description: Read any RSS or Atom feed (or a website that links one) and get clean JSON items: title, link, date, author, summary text, categories and image, plus feed title and language. Use to monitor blogs, news sites, podcasts or release notes without parsing XML.

tools.name: wikipedia_summary
tools.description: Lead summary of the Wikipedia article that best matches a topic, in any language edition: title, short description, summary paragraph, image, coordinates, Wikidata id and link. Use for quick factual background on a person, place, company or concept.

tools.name: polymarket_search
tools.description: Search open Polymarket prediction markets by keyword (election, bitcoin, fed, AI...) and get each event's markets with live outcome probabilities, best bid/ask, 24h and total volume, liquidity, end date and link. Use to answer what the market thinks will happen, or to find a market to trade.

tools.name: polymarket_top_markets
tools.description: Most active open Polymarket events right now, ranked by 24h volume, total volume or liquidity, optionally by tag (crypto, politics, sports, economy, tech, ai). Each event lists its markets with live probabilities. Use to see what traders are betting on today.

tools.name: polymarket_market
tools.description: One Polymarket market by slug, id or URL: question, rules, outcome probabilities, best bid/ask, last trade, 1-day change, volume, liquidity and the order book (top bids and asks with sizes and spread) for each outcome. An event slug returns all its markets. Use before placing a trade or to quote exa

tools.name: kalshi_search
tools.description: Search Kalshi, the US-regulated prediction exchange, for open events (Fed decisions, CPI, elections, weather, crypto prices, sports) and get every market's yes bid/ask and last price as probabilities, volume and close time. Use for US economic and political event odds.

tools.name: manifold_search
tools.description: Search Manifold Markets, the largest play-money prediction community, for open questions on AI, tech, science, politics and more, with probability, volume, bettor count and close date. Use for crowd forecasts on topics real-money markets don't cover.

tools.name: prediction_markets_search
tools.description: One query across Polymarket, Kalshi and Manifold at once: matching open events and markets with current probabilities from each, so real-money and crowd odds can be compared side by side. Use to answer 'what are the odds that...' with every major prediction market.

tools.name: crypto_fear_greed
tools.description: The Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0 extreme fear to 100 extreme greed) for today, with up to a year of daily history. Use as a market-sentiment signal for trading, newsletters or answering how the crypto market feels.

tools.name: crypto_trending
tools.description: Coins trending on CoinGecko right now (most searched in 24h) with price, 24h change, market cap and volume, plus trending categories. Use to spot what retail is looking at or find narratives gaining attention.

tools.name: crypto_coin_info
tools.description: Full profile of a coin by symbol or CoinGecko id: description, website, X/Twitter, GitHub, categories, contract addresses per chain, price, market cap, FDV, volume, 24h/7d/30d/1y change, all-time high/low and supply. Use for token research or due diligence.

tools.name: crypto_top_coins
tools.description: Top cryptocurrencies by market cap (up to 250) with price, 1h/24h/7d change, volume, all-time high and supply, optionally within a CoinGecko category (layer-1, meme-token, artificial-intelligence, real-world-assets). Use for market overviews and screeners.

tools.name: crypto_price_history
tools.description: Daily USD price history of any token (symbol, CoinGecko id or chain:address) for up to 365 days with high, low and % change, or its exact price on a past date. Use for charts, backtests, cost basis or 'what was ETH worth on...' questions.

tools.name: defi_protocols_tvl
tools.description: DeFi protocols by total value locked (DefiLlama): look up one protocol (aave, uniswap, lido) or rank them by chain and category (Lending, Dexs, Liquid Staking, Bridge...) with TVL, 1d/7d change, market cap and chains. Use for DeFi research and protocol comparisons.

tools.name: chains_tvl
tools.description: Blockchains ranked by DeFi total value locked with share of the market, gas token and chain id. Use to compare ecosystems (Ethereum, Solana, Base, Arbitrum...) or track where capital is moving.

tools.name: stablecoins_supply
tools.description: Stablecoins ranked by circulating supply (USDT, USDC, USDe, DAI...) with 1-day, 7-day and 30-day supply change, peg price, mechanism and main chains, plus total USD stablecoin supply. Use to track liquidity flowing into crypto.

tools.name: dex_volumes
tools.description: Decentralized exchange volume: total market 24h/7d and the top DEXs (Uniswap, Aerodrome, Raydium...) with 24h, 7d, 30d volume and daily change, for all chains or one chain. Use to compare DEX activity or chain usage.

tools.name: protocol_fees
tools.description: Crypto protocols ranked by fees paid by users or revenue kept (Tether, Circle, Uniswap, Hyperliquid, chains...) over 24h, 7d and 30d, for all chains or one chain. Use for fundamental analysis and protocol valuation.

tools.name: dex_pairs
tools.description: DEX trading pairs for a token symbol, name or contract address across all chains (DexScreener): price, liquidity, 24h volume, 1h/24h change, buys/sells, FDV, market cap and pair age, deepest liquidity first. Use to price new or small tokens and check if they can be traded.

tools.name: perp_funding_rates
tools.description: Perpetual futures on Hyperliquid: hourly funding rate and APR, open interest, 24h volume, mark and oracle price, max leverage, for chosen coins or ranked by open interest, funding or volume. Use for funding arbitrage, leverage sentiment and basis trades.

tools.name: exchange_ticker
tools.description: Live spot price of a crypto pair on Coinbase and Kraken: bid, ask, last, 24h open/high/low and volume, and the price gap between the two exchanges. Use for an exact executable price or a quick arbitrage check.

tools.name: crypto_candles
tools.description: OHLCV candles for a crypto pair from Coinbase Exchange at 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 6h or 1d, up to 300, oldest first. Use for charting, technical indicators (RSI, moving averages) and backtests.

tools.name: bitcoin_fees
tools.description: Bitcoin network fee rates in sat/vB for next block, 30 minutes, 1 hour and economy, plus mempool size, block height and the cost of a typical payment. Use right before sending BTC.

tools.name: bitcoin_address
tools.description: Balance of a Bitcoin address (confirmed and pending), total received and sent, transaction count and its latest 10 transactions with net amount. Use to check a BTC payment or wallet.

tools.name: bitcoin_transaction
tools.description: Status of a Bitcoin transaction: confirmed or pending, confirmations, block, time, fee and fee rate, RBF flag, inputs and outputs. Use to confirm a BTC payment or decide whether to bump a fee.

tools.name: solana_balance
tools.description: SOL and SPL token balances of a Solana wallet (Token and Token-2022), with USD values and total where a price is known. Use to check a Solana wallet or confirm a payment arrived.

tools.name: erc20_token_info
tools.description: Facts about an ERC-20 contract read from the chain (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon): name, symbol, decimals, total supply, USD price and fully diluted value. Use to verify a token address before trading or integrating it.

tools.name: npm_package
tools.description: An npm package's latest version, description, license, repository, dependencies, peer dependencies, TypeScript types, size, publish dates, deprecation and weekly downloads. Use to choose or audit a JavaScript dependency.

tools.name: pypi_package
tools.description: A Python package on PyPI: latest version, summary, license, required Python, dependencies, release date, project links and daily/weekly/monthly downloads. Use to choose or audit a Python dependency.

tools.name: rust_crate
tools.description: A Rust crate on crates.io: latest stable version, description, license, total and 90-day downloads, repository, docs, minimum Rust version and dates. Use to choose or audit a Rust dependency.

tools.name: package_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Known security vulnerabilities for an open-source package from OSV (GitHub advisories, PyPA, RustSec, Go): id, CVE aliases, summary, severity, fixed versions, for all versions or one version. Ecosystems: npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist. Use before installing or upgrading.

tools.name: cve_details
tools.description: Details of a CVE by id: description, CVSS score, severity and vector, CWE, whether it is in CISA's Known Exploited list, affected products (CPE) and references, from NVD with CVE.org fallback. Use for security triage and patch prioritisation.

tools.name: hacker_news
tools.description: Hacker News stories by keyword (by relevance or newest) or the current front page: title, link, points, comment count, author, time and discussion URL. Use to see what developers are discussing about a topic.

tools.name: arxiv_search
tools.description: Search arXiv preprints (AI, physics, math, CS, quant finance...) by keywords or field query: title, authors, abstract, categories, dates and PDF link, by relevance or newest. Use for literature review or tracking new research.

tools.name: research_papers
tools.description: Search published research papers and articles across all publishers (Crossref): title, authors, journal, year, DOI, citation count and abstract, by relevance, date or citations. Use to find and cite sources.

tools.name: book_search
tools.description: Find books by title, author or ISBN (Open Library): authors, first publication year, editions, pages, ISBNs, subjects, publishers, languages, rating and cover image. Use for book lookups, reading lists or metadata.

tools.name: ssl_certificate
tools.description: TLS certificate of a domain: whether it is valid, issuer, subject, valid-from and expiry dates, days left, all SAN hostnames, TLS version and cipher. Use for uptime/expiry monitoring or security checks.

tools.name: subdomain_finder
tools.description: Subdomains of a domain found in public Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh), with first certificate and current validity date. Use for attack-surface mapping, asset inventory or competitor research.

tools.name: http_headers
tools.description: Fetch a URL's HTTP response headers with the full redirect chain, status, server, caching and a security grade (A-F) based on HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options and other headers, listing what is missing. Use for security reviews, redirect debugging or SEO checks.

tools.name: tech_stack
tools.description: Detect the technologies a website uses from its headers and HTML: CMS (WordPress, Shopify, Webflow), frameworks (Next.js, React, Vue), CDN and hosting (Cloudflare, Vercel), analytics, chat, payments. Use for lead qualification, sales prospecting or competitor research.

tools.name: robots_sitemap
tools.description: A site's robots.txt rules per user agent, whether AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot, PerplexityBot) are blocked, and the URLs listed in its sitemap. Use before crawling a site or for SEO audits.

tools.name: ip_lookup
tools.description: Who owns an IP address (or a hostname's IP): ASN, network holder, announced prefix, regional registry, country, approximate city and coordinates, reverse DNS. Use for fraud checks, log analysis or finding a site's host.

tools.name: wayback_snapshots
tools.description: Internet Archive Wayback Machine snapshots of a URL: the capture closest to a date, plus the first and latest captures, with direct archive links. Use to see how a page looked before or recover deleted content.

tools.name: fred_series
tools.description: Any FRED economic time series by id or alias: CPI, core PCE, unemployment, payrolls, GDP, fed funds, SOFR, Treasury yields, mortgage rates, M2, oil, VIX, jobless claims... Latest value, change, 1-year % change and history. Use for macro analysis and economic questions.

tools.name: worldbank_indicator
tools.description: World Bank development data for any country: GDP, GDP per capita, growth, population, inflation, unemployment, life expectancy, CO2, exports, debt, internet use, FDI or any indicator code, by year. Use for country comparisons and market sizing.

tools.name: lei_lookup
tools.description: Look up legal entities in the global LEI register (GLEIF) by company name or 20-character LEI: exact legal name, status, legal form, jurisdiction, registration number, address and LEI renewal date. Use for KYC, counterparty checks and company identification.

tools.name: eu_vat_check
tools.description: Validate an EU VAT number live against the official EU VIES service, returning valid/invalid and the registered company name and address where the member state shares them. Use for B2B invoicing, reverse charge checks and KYC. Unavailable member states return an error and are not charged.

tools.name: iban_validate
tools.description: Validate an IBAN: country, correct length, ISO 13616 checksum, bank code and BBAN, with a reason when invalid (likely typo, wrong length). Works offline for about 80 countries. Use before sending a bank transfer or saving payout details.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description: Turn an address, place or landmark into coordinates with a structured address, or coordinates into the nearest address (reverse), from OpenStreetMap. Use for maps, delivery, distance calculations or location lookups.

tools.name: weather_forecast
tools.description: Current weather and a daily forecast (up to 9 days) for any city, address or coordinates: temperature, min/max, humidity, wind, clouds, pressure, sky and precipitation, from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute. Use for travel, events, logistics or energy planning.

tools.name: earthquakes
tools.description: Recent earthquakes worldwide or within a radius of a point (USGS): magnitude, place, time, depth, tsunami flag, PAGER alert and felt reports, over the last hour, day, week or month. Use for risk monitoring and news.

tools.name: postal_code
tools.description: Places for a postal or ZIP code in about 60 countries: place names, state or region and coordinates. Use to validate addresses, fill forms or locate customers.

tools.name: time_zone_convert
tools.description: Convert a date-time (or now) from one time zone to several others, by IANA name, city or abbreviation (Dubai, New York, PST, CET): local time, UTC offset, abbreviation, DST flag and weekday. Use to schedule meetings across time zones.

tools.name: us_company_search
tools.description: Find US-listed companies by name or ticker (e.g. 'nvidia', 'bank of america', 'TSLA'): ticker, exact SEC registrant name and CIK, best matches first. Use to resolve a company name before calling other SEC tools.

tools.name: us_company_profile
tools.description: SEC profile of a US-listed company: legal name, tickers and exchanges, industry (SIC), state of incorporation, fiscal year end, business address and phone, website, former names, filer category and links to the latest 10-K and 10-Q. Use for due diligence and company research.

tools.name: insider_trades
tools.description: Recent insider transactions at a US company from SEC Form 4 filings: insider name and role (CEO, director, 10% owner), buy/sell/award/option exercise, shares, price, value, shares held after and filing link. Set buys_sells_only to see open-market trades only. Use for insider-buying signals.

tools.name: sec_full_text_search
tools.description: Search the full text of all SEC filings since 2001 for any word or exact phrase (in quotes), filtered by form type (10-K, 8-K, S-1...) and date: company, form, filing date, period and document link. Use to find every filing mentioning a risk, product, customer or event.

tools.name: sec_metric_screen
tools.description: Rank every SEC filer by one reported metric for a period, straight from XBRL filings: revenue, net_income, operating_income, assets, cash, rnd, eps, stockholders_equity, long_term_debt, shares_outstanding or any us-gaap tag, for a year (CY2024) or quarter (CY2025Q2). Use for market-wide screens and

tools.name: crypto_market_overview
tools.description: Total crypto market capitalisation, 24h volume, Bitcoin dominance, 24h change and distance from the all-time high, in one call. Use for a market summary or risk-on/risk-off context.

tools.name: crypto_exchanges
tools.description: Centralized crypto exchanges ranked by trust score or adjusted 24h volume: name, volume, markets, supported fiat currencies, website and notices such as hacks. Use to pick a venue or check one.

tools.name: defi_lending_rates
tools.description: Supply and borrow APYs across DeFi lending markets (Aave, Compound, Morpho, Spark, Venus...) by token, chain or protocol: net borrow rate, utilisation, TVL, total borrowed and max LTV. Sort by supply_apy, borrow_apy (cheapest first) or tvl. Use to find the best place to lend or borrow.

tools.name: evm_chain_lookup
tools.description: Look up any EVM chain by chain ID or name (8453, base, arbitrum): chain ID in decimal and hex, native currency, public RPC URLs, block explorers and testnet flag. Use to configure wallets, RPCs or cross-chain apps.

tools.name: crypto_convert
tools.description: Convert an amount of any token (BTC, ETH, SOL, symbols or chain:address) into one or more fiat currencies (USD, EUR, GBP, AED, JPY, ~35 more), with the price per unit each way. Use for invoices, accounting or pricing in local currency.

tools.name: uk_grid_carbon
tools.description: Great Britain electricity carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh) now, nationally or for a postcode region, with the generation mix (wind, gas, nuclear, solar, imports) and a half-hourly forecast up to 48h including the lowest-carbon slot. Use to schedule EV charging, heat pumps or compute jobs.

tools.name: eu_power_mix
tools.description: Latest electricity generation by source (MW) for a European country (DE, FR, NL, PL, IT, AT, CH, BE...): wind, solar, nuclear, gas, coal, hydro, batteries, total load, net imports, renewable share and CO2 intensity. Use for energy dashboards, trading context or emissions reporting.

tools.name: define_word
tools.description: English dictionary entry for a word: pronunciation (IPA and audio), parts of speech, definitions with examples, synonyms and antonyms, from Wiktionary. Use for writing, learning or word games.

tools.name: word_finder
tools.description: Find words by relation: synonyms, antonyms, rhymes, near rhymes, sound-alikes, spelling patterns with * and ? wildcards, words that mean something, adjectives describing a noun and more, ranked with definitions. Use for copywriting, naming, poetry and puzzles.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Statistics for a text: words, sentences, characters, paragraphs, reading and speaking time, Flesch reading ease, Flesch-Kincaid grade, Gunning fog, complex-word share, lexical diversity and top keywords. Use to check copy, essays or SEO content.

tools.name: detect_language
tools.description: Detect the language of a text among 55 languages, with probabilities for each candidate and a reliability flag. Use to route messages, pick a translator or tag content.

tools.name: free_image_search
tools.description: Search openly licensed images (Creative Commons and public domain) from Flickr, Wikimedia and museums via Openverse: image URL, size, creator, license and a ready-made attribution line. Filter to commercially usable images. Use to illustrate posts, slides or sites legally.

tools.name: food_product
tools.description: Food product details from its EAN/UPC barcode: name, brand, quantity, ingredients, allergens, Nutri-Score, NOVA processing group, Eco-Score and nutrients per 100 g, from Open Food Facts. Use for nutrition apps, shopping assistants or allergy checks.

tools.name: university_lookup
tools.description: Universities worldwide by name and/or country, with official websites and email domains. Use to verify academic email addresses, fill forms or build education lists.

tools.name: sun_moon_times
tools.description: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, sun elevation, moonrise, moonset, moon phase and illumination for any place (name or coordinates) and date. Use for photography, prayer and event planning, solar or outdoor work.

tools.name: country_info
tools.description: Facts about a country by name or ISO code: official name, capital, region, languages, currencies, calling code, borders, area, internet TLD, coordinates, UN membership and flag. Use to enrich addresses, forms and datasets.

tools.name: domain_availability
tools.description: Check up to 20 domain names at once, or one name across several TLDs (com, ai, io...), for registration via RDAP and DNS: available or taken, registrar and expiry. Use for brainstorming product names and finding free domains.

tools.name: extract_links
tools.description: Every link on a web page with its anchor text, split into internal and external, with nofollow flags and the most-linked external domains. Use for SEO audits, crawling, backlink research or broken-link checks.

tools.name: erc20_balance
tools.description: Balance of any ERC-20 token (contract address, or USDC/USDT/DAI by symbol) for a wallet or ENS name on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon: raw and decimal-adjusted amount, symbol and decimals; up to 20 tokens per call. Use before transfers, swaps or payments.

tools.name: erc20_allowance
tools.description: How much a spender (router, Permit2, protocol) is approved to move from an owner's ERC-20 balance, with an unlimited-approval flag. Use to check approvals before a swap or to audit risky approvals.

tools.name: token_total_supply
tools.description: Total supply, name, symbol and decimals of an ERC-20 or ERC-721 contract, read on-chain. Use for market-cap math, supply checks and token due diligence.

tools.name: account_nonce
tools.description: Next transaction nonce of an EVM address (confirmed and pending), pending tx count, native balance, contract flag and EIP-7702 delegate. Use before signing or to detect stuck transactions.

tools.name: evm_network_info
tools.description: Live state of an EVM network: chain ID, latest block number and age, gas price, base and priority fee, block gas use and tx count. Use as a health check before sending transactions.

tools.name: evm_block
tools.description: An EVM block by number or tag (latest, finalized, safe): hash, parent, time, miner, gas used and limit, base fee, size and its transaction hashes.

tools.name: tx_receipt
tools.description: Receipt of a mined EVM transaction: success or revert, gas used, effective gas price, fee (and L2 L1 fee), created contract and event logs with Transfer and Approval decoded. Use to confirm a payment or swap.

tools.name: estimate_gas
tools.description: Estimate the gas a transaction will use (eth_estimateGas) and its cost at the current gas price, with a 20% buffer; fails clearly when the call would revert. Use before signing.

tools.name: storage_slot
tools.description: Read a raw storage slot of any contract (eth_getStorageAt), also decoded as uint and address. Use for proxy slots, packed variables and debugging.

tools.name: contract_info
tools.description: What is at an EVM address: wallet (with EIP-7702 delegate) or contract, bytecode size, token standard (ERC-20/721/1155), name, symbol, decimals, supply, owner() and proxy implementation. Use before interacting with an unknown address.

tools.name: proxy_check
tools.description: Detect upgradeable proxies: EIP-1967 transparent/UUPS, beacon, EIP-1822, ZeppelinOS, EIP-1167 clones and Safe-style proxies, returning implementation, admin and beacon addresses. Use for audits and to fetch the real ABI.

tools.name: read_contract
tools.description: Call any read-only contract function without a transaction or ABI file: give the signature with return types, e.g. balanceOf(address)(uint256) or getReserves()(uint112,uint112,uint32), plus arguments; returns decoded values.

tools.name: decode_calldata
tools.description: Decode EVM transaction input data: looks up the 4-byte function selector and decodes every argument (addresses, amounts, arrays). Use to see what a transaction or signing request will really do.

tools.name: nft_owner
tools.description: Current owner of an ERC-721 NFT by contract and token ID. Use to verify ownership for token gating, sales or airdrops.

tools.name: nft_metadata
tools.description: Metadata of an ERC-721 or ERC-1155 token: token URI resolved from IPFS, Arweave, data URI or https into name, description, image link and traits. Use for NFT displays, rarity or appraisal.

tools.name: event_logs
tools.description: Event logs a contract emitted (eth_getLogs), filtered by event signature such as Transfer(address,address,uint256) or a topic hash, over a block range (max 5,000 blocks, default last 100). Use to monitor swaps, mints or governance.

tools.name: erc20_transfers
tools.description: Recent ERC-20 Transfer events for a token, a wallet (in and out) or both over the last N blocks (max 5,000), with sender, receiver and amount in token units. Use to confirm incoming payments or watch whale moves.

tools.name: korean_exchange_prices
tools.description: Price of a coin in KRW on Upbit and Bithumb with 24h change, high/low and volume, plus the kimchi premium versus the global USD price. Use for Korea arbitrage signals and local pricing.

tools.name: hash_text
tools.description: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA3-256, Keccak-256, BLAKE2b and CRC32 of a text or hex/base64 bytes, plus base64 and hex encodings, in one call. Use for integrity checks, IDs, signatures and Ethereum selectors.

tools.name: jwt_decode
tools.description: Decode a JSON Web Token without verifying it: header, algorithm, payload claims, issued-at/expiry times and whether it has expired. Use to debug auth tokens and API sessions.

tools.name: token_risk_check
tools.description: Heuristic rug and honeypot risk check of an ERC-20 before buying: owner and renouncement, upgradeable proxy, mint, pause, blacklist, fee and trading switches found in the bytecode, readable buy/sell tax, and a 0-100 risk score with flags. Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon.

tools.name: aave_health_factor
tools.description: Aave V3 position of any wallet: collateral, debt and remaining borrowing power in USD, LTV, liquidation threshold, health factor and how far collateral can fall before liquidation. Use for liquidation alerts.

tools.name: whale_transfers
tools.description: Whale alerts: the largest recent ERC-20 transfers (default USDC over $1M) in the latest blocks, with sender, receiver, amount and mint/burn flag. Works for USDC, USDT, DAI or any token on 5 EVM chains.

tools.name: dex_trending_pools
tools.description: Trending or newly launched DEX pools on Base, Solana, Ethereum, BSC and more: token, price, FDV, liquidity, 24h volume, price change and buy/sell counts. Use to spot new memecoins and momentum early.

tools.name: x402_api_search
tools.description: Find the right pay-per-call API for a task: searches the x402 Bazaar and ranks results by real 30-day payers, with URL, price in USDC, network and description. Use before choosing which paid tool to call.

tools.name: sanctions_name_screen
tools.description: Screen a person or company name against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list including aliases, with fuzzy matching: match score, entity type, sanctions programs and remarks. Use for KYC, payouts and onboarding.

tools.name: sanctions_wallet_check
tools.description: Check up to 50 crypto addresses (ETH, BTC, TRX, USDT, SOL and more) against the OFAC SDN list's digital currency addresses: PASS or BLOCK with the sanctioned party and program. Use as a pre-payment AML gate.

tools.name: central_bank_rates
tools.description: Current policy interest rates of about 40 central banks (Fed, ECB, BoE, BoJ, PBoC, SNB, RBI...) with the date of the latest value, highest first, from the BIS. Filter by country or currency code.

tools.name: fx_carry_ranking
tools.description: FX carry trade ranking from central-bank policy rates: currency pairs ranked by interest-rate differential, optionally for one funding currency such as JPY or CHF.

tools.name: economic_calendar
tools.description: This week's macroeconomic calendar: CPI, jobs, GDP, PMIs and central-bank decisions with time (UTC), currency, impact, forecast and previous value. Filter by impact (High, Medium, Low) and currency.

tools.name: airport_status
tools.description: Live US airport disruptions from the FAA: closures, ground stops, ground delay programs and arrival or departure delays with reason, average and max delay and expected end. Filter by airport code (JFK, LAX).

tools.name: email_security
tools.description: Email authentication audit of a domain: MX, SPF (lookup count and policy), DMARC policy and reporting, DKIM on common selectors, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT and BIMI, graded A-F with fixes. Use for deliverability and phishing-risk checks.

tools.name: agent_readiness
tools.description: Score 0-100 how ready a website is for AI agents: llms.txt, agent card, MCP manifest, OpenAPI spec, x402 payments, AI-crawler rules in robots.txt, sitemap and structured data, with suggestions.

tools.name: expand_url
tools.description: Expand a short or tracking link (bit.ly, t.co, lnkd.in...) hop by hop without opening the final page: every redirect, final URL and host, and a clean URL with tracking parameters removed. Use to check links safely.

tools.name: file_type
tools.description: Detect a file's real format from its first bytes (magic numbers), given as base64 or hex: MIME type, extension and a warning when it does not match the file name. Use to validate uploads.

tools.name: encode_decode
tools.description: Encode or decode text: base64, base64url, hex, URL percent-encoding, HTML entities, ROT13, binary, Unicode escapes and punycode, or detect to try decoding unknown input.

tools.name: json_tools
tools.description: Validate JSON (with line and column of errors), pretty-print, minify, sort keys, list all paths, show its shape, or extract a value by path like $.items[0].name or $.items[*].

tools.name: dockerfile_lint
tools.description: Lint a Dockerfile for security and best practice: unpinned or latest images, running as root, secrets in ENV/ARG, curl piped to sh, ADD of URLs, apt and pip caches, sudo, chmod 777, missing HEALTHCHECK. Scored.

tools.name: random_values
tools.description: Cryptographically secure random values: UUID v4 or v7, strong passwords, hex or URL-safe tokens, integers in a range, dice rolls or coin flips, up to 100 at once.

tools.name: cron_explain
tools.description: Explain a cron expression (5 fields, names like mon-fri, or @daily) in plain English and list its next run times in any UTC offset. Use to check schedules before deploying jobs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_web_page, dns_lookup, url_metadata, email_validate, read_rss_feed, arxiv_search, http_headers, free_image_search, x402_api_search, expand_url · Private data: website_contact_details, crypto_token_prices, evm_wallet_balance, evm_transaction_status, ens_resolve, defi_yields, dns_lookup, qr_code, crypto_coin_info, crypto_top_coins, crypto_price_history, chains_tvl, dex_pairs, bitcoin_address, solana_balance, erc20_token_info, sec_full_text_search, defi_lending_rates, crypto_convert, erc20_balance, token_total_supply, contract_info, read_contract, nft_owner, nft_metadata, erc20_transfers, jwt_decode, token_risk_check, aave_health_factor, whale_transfers, dex_trending_pools, sanctions_wallet_check, file_type, dockerfile_lint, random_values · Public sink: read_web_page, app_store_details, ens_resolve, dns_lookup, url_metadata, email_validate, chains_tvl, npm_package, eu_power_mix, text_stats, university_lookup, email_security · Destructive: file_type, cron_explain.
